author: SciShow
description:
It's not every day you're working on a movie for a planetarium, meant to teach audiences about the solar system, and accidentally make a discovery ABOUT our solar system. We spoke with Dr. Jackie Faherty at the American Museum of Natural History to learn more about what she and her collaborators uncovered about our Oort Cloud.

Hosted by: Savannah Geary (they/them)
